description_short: Re-establishment or protection of forest/tree cover on degraded, deforested or non-forest land, spanning the restoration continuum from passive natural regeneration through assisted regeneration to active planting.
description_technical: Forest restoration re-establishes forest structure, composition and function on degraded or deforested land. Suitability is reasoned along the restoration continuum: passive natural regeneration (recovery after pressure removal, gated by regeneration potential — seed-source proximity, residual cover, low disturbance), assisted natural regeneration (barrier removal + management where regeneration potential is partial), and active planting (reforestation/afforestation/enrichment, gated by the planting envelope for target species where natural regeneration will not deliver). Coastal mangrove restoration (distinct coastal-hydrology driver) and forest protection/CBFM (existing standing forest x threat x governance) are registered but parked pending scope sign-off. Distinct from agroforestry regeneration-on-farmland (on-farm vs forest/non-farm land).
